title: Captured: the 18:00 daily sync's direction, action items and open questions (4 November)
detail:
Captured by conductor@web-summit.jose at Jose's word, from Jose's notes (4 November, the 18:00 daily sync). Jose's words, not a transcript: each decider's own words still close their items (WS-107). Nothing filed: existing issues linked; where none exists, it says so.

Directions:
1. Everyone does a daily interview led by their conductor: what I learned, how my work changed, how it felt. Done in Claude voice mode, written up as markdown. Owner: every person, with their conductor (WS-41, WS-47, WS-07).
2. Business cards: three summit-branded designs with the same message and no names, about 200 of each, one per audience, taglines from the /print page. Exec: "Do you know what your agents are doing?" GRC: "My agents have a policy. Do yours?" Security: "Your AI has access. Does it have permission?" Owner (suggested by the conductor): Indi (print), Dinis (approval) (WS-155, WS-142, WS-146).
3. Routine observability data goes through scheduled agents. Urgent work needs a real notification. Owner (suggested by the conductor): Jose and Angelo (the observability workflow) (WS-37); no issue yet for the urgent notification.
4. Newsroom pipeline: researcher, curator, journalist, correspondent. Owner (suggested by the conductor): Vicky (the researcher first), newsroom@web-summit.dinis (WS-14, WS-141).

Action items:
- Build and test the observability workflow end to end. Owner: Jose with Angelo (WS-37).
- Public slides on LinkedIn; add the team as operators of the LinkedIn page. Owner: Dinis (WS-126).
- Taglines for approval; print the cards; check QR-code stickers, three concepts. Owner: Indi (WS-155).
- Token and context optimisation; practise onboarding someone with a real example; help/FAQ on the site. Owner: Angelo (WS-148, WS-35, WS-124); WS-148 is Indi's accountant, the nearest issue for token use; no issue yet for the help/FAQ.
- Newsroom researcher, pipeline running by Friday. Owner: Vicky (WS-14, WS-141).

Open:
- Tagline and sticker approval (WS-155).
- Who manages the LinkedIn page (WS-126).
- How vault entries are never left unprocessed (WS-114).
- Two people still without a key (WS-136).
- Briefs that are easier to read (show one-way and two-way decisions) (WS-112).
source: Jose Bota's notes, given to conductor@web-summit.jose. Not verbatim.
